Compartment 4.16.0 ensures `/learn` and its equivalents stay strictly additive across every major coding agent and expands the built-in offline starter pack with 200 curated agentic AI and developer reference facts (6,864 starter memories total), 100% offline, with zero network calls of any kind and a portable, encrypted `.vault` file you own and can back up or copy anywhere, local disk, USB, NAS, or any cloud drive, like any other file.

## What's New

### Strictly Additive `/learn`, Rules, and Skills Across Every Agent
- **Default host rule and skill updates first, Compartment alongside:** Recalled Compartment memories are strictly untrusted `DATA`, never executable instructions, so behavioral rules, coding standards, and multi-step workflows must always live in each agent's own trusted instruction and skill files too. Every Compartment instruction surface now explicitly preserves the host's default learning flow first and updates Compartment in addition (`memory_store` / `memory_store_many`, `supersedes`, and `memory_forget` / `compartment_forget`):
  - **Claude Code (`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`):** Preserves `/memory`, `/init`, `/learn`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/rules/*.md`, and `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` updates first, while keeping Compartment as the encrypted replacement for unencrypted `memory/` note folders and updating durable facts, opinions, and deletions in Compartment alongside them.
  - **OpenAI Codex (`$CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md`):** Preserves `/init`, `$skill-creator`, `/learn`, `AGENTS.md`, and `SKILL.md` updates first, plus Compartment updates in addition.
  - **Hermes Agent (`~/.hermes/plugins/compartment`):** Preserves Hermes's `/learn` command, `skill_manage` (`~/.hermes/skills/`), and `AGENTS.md` / `SOUL.md` / `USER.md` updates first, plus `compartment_store`, `supersedes`, and `compartment_forget` in addition.
  - **AntiGravity (`~/.gemini/config/rules/compartment.md`):** Preserves `/learn` (`learning_proposal.md` targeting `GEMINI.md` / `.agents/rules/*.md` and `SKILL.md`) first, plus Compartment additions, updates, and deletions once approved.
  - **Universal MCP Handshake & Gemini CLI (`COMPARTMENT_INSTRUCTIONS` & `GEMINI.md`):** Delivers the same additive `/learn`, rules, and skills guarantee automatically to OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, VS Code, Continue, Goose, OpenCode, and every other MCP client.
- **One-command refresh for existing installs:** Run `compartment integrate --refresh` (or re-click your agent in the Compartment app) to bring existing `CLAUDE.md`, Codex `AGENTS.md`, AntiGravity rules, and Hermes plugins up to date in place while preserving your own notes.

### 200 New Agentic AI & Developer Starter Memories (`starter.mpack` v1.6.0, 6,864 Total)
- **Model Context Protocol (`ai-mcp`):** MCP server/client primitives, `stdio` JSON-RPC stdout discipline, Streamable HTTP, tool annotations, GUI `PATH` (`spawn ENOENT`) troubleshooting, and verified MCP config file paths and schema keys across Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, AntiGravity, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code (`servers`), Zed (`context_servers`), OpenCode (`mcp`), Cline, Continue, Goose, and LM Studio.
- **Coding Agent Harnesses (`ai-harness`):** `AGENTS.md` and `AGENTS.override.md` hierarchies, `SKILL.md` progressive disclosure, `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` deterministic hooks vs. advisory prompts, headless CLI modes (`claude -p`, `codex exec`), and opinion superseding vs. fact accumulation.
- **Context Engineering, Multi-Agent Workflows, & Agent Security (`ai-agent`):** Context rot, prompt prefix KV-cache stability, subagent context isolation, independent diff verification, the lethal trifecta of prompt injection, Markdown image exfiltration, untrusted repo execution vectors, symlink traversal, hardware/agent key isolation, and jittered `429`/`529` backoff.
- **LLM Inference, Structured Outputs, & Embeddings (`ai-llm`):** KV-cache sizing math, GQA and MLA, prefill vs. memory-bandwidth-bound decode, Mixture-of-Experts RAM vs. active-weight speed, Apple Silicon unified memory, `safetensors` vs. `pickle`, `GGUF`, `ONNX`, `MLX`, grammar-constrained JSON Schema decoding, speculative decoding, and L2-normalized / Matryoshka embeddings.
- **Developer Operations (`dev-git`, `dev-python`, `dev-ops`, `macos`, `linux`):** Parallel `git worktree` workflows, `git bisect run`, `--force-with-lease`, GitHub SSH over port 443, PEP 668 / `uv` / `uvx` / PEP 723, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` for signed bundles, `127.0.0.1` vs. `0.0.0.0` binding, SQLite WAL + `busy_timeout`, atomic `fsync` + `os.replace`, Docker layer caching, macOS Hardened Runtime / `notarytool` / `stapler` / Secure Enclave, and Linux `systemctl --user` / `loginctl enable-linger`.
